bitfield.description: 3 msb (bits 23:21) of the PRAM base address

Nab Soket Jump table address. Each Table entry contain a 4B pointer to related socket DB entry.
the value of this register is locked upon MEM_HIF_STATUS_LOCK @Init.
In BSD_BYPASS Mode, when nab serves SDIO, only socket 0 DB exists in table. the rest 124B were increased to 124W are used to hold the Tx info table that is returned to the SDIO host at the end of each rcv() request.
In the BSD_BYPASS Mode there is a restriction on value that can be set: MUST BE 128W aligned! since 2 lsb's are always 0 it means that MMR Fiels 7 LSBs MEM_SKT_JUMP_TBL_ADDR[6:0] should be set as 0

Nab Sub descriptor RAM Base address.
the value of this register is locked upon MEM_HIF_STATUS_LOCK @Init.
In BSD_BYPASS Mode, when nab doesn't use the sud RAM, this register contains an MMR address. This MMR, plus pre-defined number of successive MMR's, return to the SDIO host as status information (a.k.a. Status 2) at the end of each rcv() request.
In the BSD_BYPASS Mode there is a restriction on value that can be set: MUST BE 16W aligned! since 2 lsb's are always 0 it means that MMR Fiels 4 LSBs MEM_SUD_RAM_STS2_ADDR[3:0] should be set as 0
